limitations: Host framework instances are synthetic; original packaged image is never executed. Real Foundation archival, Objective-C runtime, and CoreGraphics bitmap rendering execute offline.
setVisibleSections: is preserved as a 64-bit integer slot; the private host enum name is not proved by packaged instructions.
Opaque HUD message and dismissal handler objects are forwarded unchanged; their private concrete classes are not proved.
Associated-object storage uses one private static address instead of the packaged getter address; retain-nonatomic policy and public property attributes are preserved.
Canonical ytpBool/ytpInt retain the parent-owned local preference policy.
